Spending limits and savings piggy banks in Cidna

Set a limit per category and create a piggy bank per goal, straight from the home screen.

Last updated: 2026-10-29

On this pageA limit for every categoryA piggy bank per goalA few tips

A limit for every category

On the home screen find the spending-limits card and tap “set a new limit”. Pick a category such as food and dining and set a monthly ceiling; the progress bar and alerts show how much is used.

A piggy bank per goal

Find the savings piggy banks card and tap “create a new piggy bank”. Enter the target amount; each piggy bank shows its own progress as a percentage.

  • Manual deposits and withdrawals
  • Scheduled monthly deposits

A few tips

  • Start limits from your last three months’ average, not from wishful thinking.
  • One piggy bank per goal; don’t mix them so each progress stays visible.
